posts.title: Claude Code and my pull requests live on my BUSY Bar now
posts.description: A desk gadget with an LED strip, a knob and an open HTTP API. It shows what Claude Code is doing, and after a firmware update broke that, it got a pull request app too.

posts.title: I talk to Claude Code with one hand
posts.description: A Keychron Nape Pro under my keyboard now does three jobs. The middle button talks through Wispr Flow, and M1 and M2 send Enter and Esc, which covers most of a Claude Code session.

posts.title: I built a Greek pottery roguelite with Claude Code in a weekend
posts.description: Project Sisyphus went from an empty folder to a playable roguelite on my iPhone. The best design decision was noticing that programmer art and ancient vase painting are the same thing.
